_comment: Keyed by DOI (lowercase) or, if no DOI, the normalized lowercase title. Each value may set tag, byline, why, cites — all optional. byline defaults to the author list ORCID reports (contributors with a credit-name) joined by commas; set it here only to override/fix that. Example below (remove the leading underscore key when you add real entries).

10.1000/example-doi.byline: De Felice F. G., et al.
10.1000/example-doi.why: Why it matters — one sentence on the finding's significance.
